text:
TERRIBLE experience at this dental clinic - **UPDATE regarding the response below: The 500 baht consultation fee was never communicated to me verbally, and I made this clear to customer service when I spoke with them at the clinic. My appointment was at 5 PM and I was kept waiting for 30 minutes, during which I signed a form where I was supposedly agreeing to pay that amount. In addition, during all the previous days communicating via Line, I was never informed that I would be charged 500 baht for a simple consultation --- I went in for a consultation and only spoke with the doctor for about two minutes because my issue could not be treated at that time. As I was leaving, I was CHARGED 500 baht with no receipt and no clear explanation.

When I asked why, the staff could not explain it properly. Later they said it was for equipment sterilization, even though no equipment was used. I only had a brief conversation with the doctor.

I have lived in Thailand for three years and never had this kind of experience at a dental clinic before. A customer service team later contacted me and the issue was resolved, but they claimed I had agreed to pay 500 baht when signing a form. This was never explained to me, and I believed I was just signing a standard patient form.

Very poorly handled and extremely overpriced for Bangkok. I would not recommend this clinic.
